mapper.select: SELECT ticker FROM instruments WHERE ticker = #{symbol} AND tradable = TRUE

SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(h.quantity) FROM portfolio_holdings h INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND i.ticker = #{symbol} ), 0) AS held, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(o.quantity) FROM orders o INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = o.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND i.ticker = #{symbol} AND o.status = 'NEW' AND o.side = 'BUY' ), 0) AS pendingBuy, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(o.quantity) FROM orders o INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = o.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND i.ticker = #{symbol} AND o.status = 'NEW' AND o.side = 'SELL' ), 0) AS pendingSell
SELECT external_order_id FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
